beta.description:
This is the innitial beta release of stk archipelago.

## Installation

### AP Setup (the normal archipelago apworld and options setup)
- download the APWorld and send it to the host
- install the APWorld using the [archipelago launcher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- restart the launcher
- use the **option creator** to create the yaml options and send them to the host

### Client Setup
- download the game client for your system, open it and execute the run_game.sh/bat file (doubleclick on windows)
- when the game has finished loading, press story. A new menu should open where you can enter the server details (server address, slot name and password)
**WARNING: If you already have a player that has the same name as your slot name, the game will delete it and recreate the player, resetting all your campain progress so choose your slot name wisely**

_Note: if your game crashes while loading, restart the game and delete the created player with the same name as your slot name_

### Known bugs
- when your receive all the keys while in the overworld, the door looks open but you cannot enter it. Just join any challenge and quit as soon as you loaded in to fix this

APWorld repository: https://github.com/Batknight21/STK-APworld

v0.9.1.description:
**For the setup guide see [set up guide](/SET_UP_GUIDE.md)**

Several bug fixes:
- locked difficulty was still selected in select_challenge.cpp if higher difficulty was played somewhere else
- all keys have to be unlocked and all challenges completed for the big door to fake open in the overworld
- quitting to the menu now clears all messages
- prelocated track items where also generated in the multiword
- select_challenge was sometimes selecting easy difficulty or crashing when entering a race

### Known bugs (still):
- when your receive all the keys while in the overworld, the door looks open but you cannot enter it. Just join any challenge and quit as soon as you loaded in to fix this
- game crashes when connecting. Just restart and delete the player with the same name as the slot name

### Future todo:
- show connection status in overworld gui
- change messages
- fix remaining bugs

APWorld repo: https://github.com/Batknight21/STK-APworld
